Context caching price | Not available | $0.0375 (text / image / video)

sources.supports: Google's June 16 pricing snapshot, before the models.dev commit, already listed $0.0375 per million tokens for context caching in the Gemini 2.5 Flash preview pricing section.

sources.quote: - Released `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20`, a Gemini [preview](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models#model-versions) model optimized for price-performance and adaptive thinking.
sources.supports: Google's changelog identifies the model version corresponding to the pricing section.

notes: The provider's June 16 pricing snapshot already included the $0.0375 context caching charge, so the later models.dev addition was a correction of its omitted cache field. The sources do not state when Google first introduced this charge.
